top_findings.title: Sanctum token TTL flap during long sessions
top_findings.detail: The admin Bearer token expired mid-test, causing /api/admin/cash-overview to 401 → axios interceptor in resources/js/app.js:171 dispatches logout + push to auth.login. This is correct behavior for security but disruptive for long automated capture sessions. Not a Q5-Q8 defect — pre-existing behavior. Already on V1.0.1 backlog (BRAIN §9 'V1.0.1 roadmap: TTL 8h → 1h sensitive ops'). For this audit, mitigated by re-login between state captures.
top_findings.action: None — V1.0.1 backlog item already tracked.
